title: Apparently, Disillusioned Adventurers Will Save the World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Veteran adventurer Nick is expelled from his party, accused of embezzlement and dumped by a scammer girlfriend. Over drinks he meets three others ruined by betrayal: the disgraced noble mage Tiana, the dragonkin warrior Curran, and Zem, a priest expelled from the Church after a false accusation. They form a new party, working on their vices while taking on dungeons and corruption.
life_message: People burned by betrayal can learn to trust again by building a small, honest team and working on their own failings.
